newsitem.title: GERMANY: Two Bundesbank officials to speak on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Two Bundesbank officials to speak on Thursday.

text.p: Two senior Bundesbank officials will speak at two separate events on Thursday, the central bank said.
Bundesbank chief economist Otmar Issing is scheduled to speak at the University of Nuremberg at 1700 GMT. The topic of the speech was not released.

Bundesbank council member Hans-Juergen Koebnick will speak at a banking forum in Homburg at 1800 GMT. Koebnick, also president of the state central bank in the Rhineland-Palatinate and Saar regions, will speak about Europe's planned currency union.
